sources.title: [PATCH v3 4/5] media: ipu-bridge: Add the OV02C10 26 MHz link frequency

claims.claim: With a 26 MHz external clock the OV02C10 runs its CSI-2 link at 399.479167 MHz instead of 400 MHz. Add that link frequency to the OVTI02C1 entry so the sensor driver can use it. Signed-off-by: Felipe Calliari <calliarifelipe@gmail.com> --- Notes: Changes in v3: - New patch. The ov02c10 now advertises the 26 MHz link frequency on its own (Sakari), so the bridge has to list it. drivers/media/pci/intel/ipu-bridge.c | 2 +- 1 file changed , 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-) diff --git a/drivers/media/pci
